card.name: Insulin and self-injection wording
card.fires_on: The word insulin (at its 'ulin' ending), and words like 'self' or 'long-term' just before injection, pump or administration terms, mainly in diabetes and injectable-drug label text.

modes.label: Insulin before injections/pump
modes.description: The end of the word insulin right before 'injections' or 'pump'.

modes.label: Self-administration lead-in
modes.description: The word 'self' before a hyphen in self-administer or self-use of an injected drug.
modes.example: Adult patients may<< self>>-administer COSENTYX or be

modes.label: Long-term treatment wording
modes.description: 'of' or '-term' after 'long' when discussing lasting treatment such as dialysis.
modes.example: to overcome the long<<-term>> problems of artificial kidney treatment.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about injections, injecting, pumps and lifelong or weekly treatment.
card.plain: It fires when the text is leading into injected, ongoing treatment such as insulin shots or self-injection.
